repos_data.description: Local-first, auditable memory layer for AI apps and coding agents — Codex, Claude Code, MCP, HTTP, TypeScript, and Python.

repo_meta_data.description: The open MCP client for SAIHM sovereign agent memory — eight tools any MCP agent uses to reach a SAIHM operator endpoint. Implements the publicly documented SAIHM memory protocol (Independent-Submission Internet-Draft; not an IETF standard). Pairs with @saihm/client-pro. Evaluate it offline first with the runnable demos.
